title: 第13章 人口统计第14章 穷
slug: 帝皇在上第699章兵临城下
lines: 当罗德站在高台之上。
顶着黑眼圈的诺里斯才带着法修斯学士赶到了港口。
他去大宅寻找罗德汇报工作却慢了一步。
在从男仆那里得到消息后就抓紧时间赶了过来。
对他而言这件事早点结束，他才好松一口气。
不过此时登上了高台的罗德显然没有聆听汇报的意思。
只见他大手一挥。
菲利普立刻向前一步，举起了长长的领主号角。
号角被凑到嘴边吹响。
悠扬的号角声也在港口中回荡着。
这种足有半米长的魔兽号角音色嘹亮。
属于当地领主才能动用的规格。
连绵不断的号角声考验着菲利普的肺活量。
绵长的号音瞬间就吸引了所有人的注意。
随着余音的渐渐消散。
个头小小的克罗恩为他递上了喇叭形的简易扩音器。
刚到港口没多久，克罗恩就顺便收服了一只矶鹬鸟。
这种小鸟儿的背部为黑褐色，腹部则是一片绒白。
在冬季到来时它们就会南迁。
小矶鹬站在克罗恩的肩头，时不时还会歪着头打量罗德。
“小东西。”
罗德勾起嘴角，伸出一根手指揉了揉它的脑袋。
农管对空抽鞭，大声催促农奴们起身前往高台前方的空地集合。
熙熙攘攘的农奴蹒跚而行，好似汇聚而来的黑色虫群。
罗德安静的矗立在高台上。
直到人都集合的差不多了才举起手中的喇叭筒。
他开门见山。
“我是罗德?奥尔德林。”
“黑滩镇领主，你们的主人！”
“在我来此之前，人们告诉我黑滩镇是个贫瘠之地。”
“黑水海盗年年勒索，高岭蛮族时常骚扰！”
“冬天冻得发抖，连肚子也填不饱。”
“以前的日子怎么样，我很清楚。”
“而你们在期盼着什么，我也很清楚。”
“想吃饱饭，想住在不漏风的屋子里？”
“那就献上你们的忠诚！”
罗德放眼望去。
人群密密麻麻却鸦雀无声。

When Rhodes stood on the high platform.
Norris, who had dark circles under his eyes, rushed to the port with Bachelor Facius.
He went to the mansion to find Rhodes to report, but was a step too late.
After getting the news from the valet, he rushed over as soon as possible.
It would be a relief for him that this matter would be over soon.
However, Rhodes, who was on the high platform at this time, obviously had no intention of listening to the report.
I saw him wave his hand.
Philip immediately took a step forward and raised the long lord's horn.
The horn was brought to his lips and sounded.
The melodious sound of horns also echoed in the port.
"Woo~"
This half-meter-long Warcraft horn has a loud sound.
It is a specification that can only be used by local lords.
The continuous blast of horns tested Philip's lung capacity.
The long trumpet tone instantly attracted everyone's attention.
As the lingering sound gradually dissipated.
The small Crohn handed him a trumpet-shaped simple loudspeaker.
Not long after arriving at the port, Crohn tamed a sandpiper.
This small bird has a dark brown back and a downy white belly.
They migrate south when winter comes.
The little sandpiper stood on Crohn's shoulder, tilting his head to look at Rhodes from time to time.
"Little thing."
Rhodes raised the corners of his mouth and stretched out a finger to rub its head.
The farm manager whipped his whip in the air and loudly urged the serfs to get up and gather in the open space in front of the high platform.
The bustling serfs staggered forward like a gathering swarm of black insects.
Rhodes stood quietly on the high platform.
It wasn't until everyone was almost gathered that he raised the loudspeaker in his hand.
He got right to the point.
"I'm Rod Aldrin."
"Lord of Black Beach Town, your master!"
"Before I came here, people told me Blackshore was a barren place."
"The Blackwater pirates extort money every year, and the high mountain barbarians often harass us!"
"I'm shivering with cold in the winter, and I can't even fill my stomach."
"I know very well what it was like in the past."
"And I know very well what you are expecting."
"Want to have enough to eat and live in a house that is airtight?"
"Then offer your loyalty!"
Rhodes looked around.
The crowd was dense but silent.
